title.full: What to do with the deceased's NRIC

summary.text: You do not need to surrender the deceased’s NRIC. It is automatically invalidated when the death is registered.

details.heading: Prevent misuse
details.body: You may destroy the invalidated NRIC, or punch a hole in it.

example_phrasings: Do I need to surrender the deceased's NRIC to the police station or ICA for physical invalidation?
Must I hand in the deceased's NRIC?
What should I do with the deceased's NRIC?

sources.page_title: Do I need to surrender the deceased's NRIC to the police station or ICA for physical invalidation?

quotes.text: There is no longer a need to surrender the deceased’s NRIC for physical invalidation. The deceased’s NRIC will be automatically invalidated in ICA’s system once the death is registered.
To prevent misuse, you may either destroy the invalidated NRIC, or punch a hole in it.
